name: tactica-example
description: Example project demonstrating tactica usage with mnemonica

scripts.use:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.dependencies.mnemonica='1.2.9';p.dependencies.typeomatica='0.3.62';p.devDependencies['@mnemonica/tactica']='0.2.0';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,'\t')+'\n');console.log('Switched to PUBLIC npm dependencies (pinned)');" && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.use:local: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.dependencies.mnemonica='file:../core';p.dependencies.typeomatica='file:../typeomatica';p.devDependencies['@mnemonica/tactica']='file:../tactica';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,'\t')+'\n');console.log('Switched to LOCAL file: dependencies');" && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
